note: Rewritten from the species description in Syaukani & Thompson (2016), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown in the original (Imago. Unknown.), hence no such section; only the major worker is described, minor workers appearing only in figures 6—13; the original gives no worker measurements; in Table 1 the holotype nasus index of 0.55 is inconsistent with the range 0.60—0.61 and is reproduced as printed; figure numbers, type material, comparisons and biological observations are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule pale brown to orange, the vertex yellow and the nasus dark brown, the antennae and the maxillary and labial palps black, in sharp contrast to the pale head capsule; soldiers of other Hospitalitermes in the Indo-Malayan and Austro-Malayan subregions have the head capsule and antennae both black, without such contrast. The posterior margin of the head capsule also has a minute median notch, and in dorsal view the posterior and central parts of the head capsule are elongate, whereas they are shorter and rounded in other closely related species; in profile the dorsal margin of the head capsule (including the nasus) is weakly concave. Alates not seen.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Monotypic. Head capsule pale brown to orange, vertex yellow, nasus dark brown (paler at the base, darker at the apex); antennae uniformly black, in marked contrast to the head capsule; pronotum darker than the head capsule in dorsal view; abdominal tergites golden orange to pale brown; coxae dark brown, femora and tibiae pale brown to dark brown. Head capsule strongly narrowed behind the antennal sockets in dorsal view, the anterior part excluding the nasus distinctly smaller than the posterior part; posterior margin nearly straight medially, with a minute median notch; in profile the dorsal margin of the head capsule (including the nasus) weakly concave, the posterior part well developed. Nasus in dorsal view longer than half the head capsule that receives it, much wider at the base than at the apex. Antenna 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than 4, segments 4 and 5 subequal, segments 6—14 progressively shorter. Pronotum in dorsal view with the anterior margin moderately concave medially, the posterior margin arcuately convex. Measurements (8 nests, 20 soldiers, mm; holotype/range): head length including nasus 1.72/1.64—1.72, head length excluding nasus 1.18/1.01—1.19, nasus length 0.65/0.63—0.65, nasus index 0.55/0.60—0.61, maximum anterior head width 0.58/0.55—0.60, maximum posterior head width 1.06/1.00—1.07, maximum head capsule height (excluding postmentum) 0.82/0.75—0.82, pronotum length 0.37/0.32—0.37, pronotum width 0.62/0.56—0.63.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule dark brown to black; frontal suture pale brown; frontal gland pore brown to dark brown; labrum pale brown to dark brown; clypeus dark brown to black; anteclypeus dark brown; antennae dark brown to black. Antenna 15-segmented, segment 3 longer than 4, segment 4 slightly shorter than 5, segments 6—15 progressively longer. Left mandible: apical tooth distinctly shorter than marginal tooth 1; anterior margin of marginal tooth 1 distinctly longer than its posterior margin; marginal tooth 2 absent, merged into the cutting edge between marginal teeth 1 and 3; marginal tooth 3 smaller than marginal tooth 1, projecting slightly from the cutting edge and separated from the molar prominence by a distinct gap; marginal tooth 4 reduced, entirely hidden behind the molar prominence. Right mandible: anterior margin of marginal tooth 1 curved downwards; marginal tooth 2 faintly visible, separated from the much larger marginal tooth 1; posterior margin of marginal tooth 2 straight; outline of the molar plate faintly visible; the cockroach-like notch on the molar plate absent. Minor workers are illustrated only and are not separately described in the original. Worker measurements are not given in the original.
